label: Restriction Type
description: A Fund's accounting restriction status -- whether its use is constrained by the donor, and if so, how. `donor-restricted` is the broader designation covering both time-limited and perpetual donor restrictions; `temporarily-restricted` and `permanently-restricted` narrow it to which kind.

values.label: Unrestricted
values.definition: The fund carries no donor-imposed restriction on its use.

values.label: Donor-Restricted
values.definition: The fund's use is constrained by the donor, without specifying here whether the constraint is time-limited or perpetual.

values.label: Temporarily Restricted
values.definition: The fund's donor-imposed restriction expires after a specific time or purpose is satisfied.

values.label: Permanently Restricted
values.definition: The fund's donor-imposed restriction never expires.
